stories.title: Researchers use digital twins to model EV charging
stories.summary: Researchers at Ningbo University of Finance and Economics used machine learning and digital twins to analyze 348,404 electric vehicle charging sessions. The study suggests that offline decision models can reduce daily electricity costs by 3.31 percent and peak demand by 3.14 percent when real-time telemetry is unavailable.

stories.title: Aetina launches in-vehicle edge AI system
stories.summary: Aetina Corporation has released its NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin-powered DeviceEdge AIE-VX28/18-IP for mass production. The fanless, IP66-rated system supports up to 12 camera inputs and is designed for real-time video analytics in harsh environments. It includes ignition power control for surge protection.

stories.title: SEMA Show introduces content creator showcase
stories.summary: The 2026 SEMA Show has launched the Content Creator Corral, a dedicated space for automotive influencers to display their custom vehicle builds. The feature expands on the organization's Road to SEMA initiative, which tracks creators as they travel to the annual event in Las Vegas.

stories.title: GM uses virtual tools for vehicle redesigns
stories.summary: General Motors is using AI-powered virtual tools to accelerate the redesign process for its Silverado and Sierra truck lines. The company claims these technologies streamline development cycles. Full details regarding the specific implementation and efficiency gains are currently restricted to subscribers of the original publication.

stories.title: Sasken partners with European automaker on connectivity
stories.summary: Sasken Technologies has signed a multi-year engineering contract with a European automotive group. The firm will provide software development, systems integration, and hardware validation services for next-generation telematics control units. The deal marks a strategic expansion of Sasken's role in the European automotive software market.

stories.title: Dealerships leverage AI for employee productivity
stories.summary: Two award-winning dealerships are integrating AI tools to boost staff productivity and operational efficiency. The companies report that these technologies assist in managing daily workflows and performance metrics. Further analysis of these specific dealership practices is available only to subscribers of the original report.

stories.title: Cubic3 explores reusable autonomy
stories.summary: Cubic3 suggests that as autonomous technology becomes reusable, the vehicle itself shifts from a product to a business model. The company posits that this transition will redefine how manufacturers approach long-term value. The full analysis is restricted to subscribers of the platform.

stories.title: Government considers easing vehicle ownership transfers
stories.summary: The government is reportedly developing new policies intended to simplify the process of transferring vehicle ownership. Officials indicate that current administrative hurdles are under review to improve ease of use for owners. Specific details on the proposed policy changes are currently unavailable.

stories.title: US tariff relief remains unlikely for Indian auto parts
stories.summary: Industry executives suggest that US tariffs on Indian auto components are unlikely to change despite legislative shifts in Congress. Trade talks stalled earlier this year following threats of 100 percent tariffs related to Russian oil imports. A presidential veto remains a significant barrier to policy reform.

stories.title: EU committee votes to adjust 2035 emissions targets
stories.summary: The European Parliament Environment Committee has voted to modify 2035 automotive emissions rules. Proposed changes include lowering the fleet-wide reduction target from 100 percent to 87.5 percent. Further details on the committee's legislative path are restricted to subscribers of the original publication.

stories.title: Indian racers pursue Formula 1 ambitions
stories.summary: Young Indian drivers are navigating significant financial and logistical challenges to reach Formula 1. Despite the dominance of cricket in India, racers like Saishiva Sankaran and Viswas Vijayaraj are competing internationally to secure a breakthrough. The path remains defined by limited domestic opportunities and high costs.

stories.title: NASCAR championship weekend schedule
stories.summary: NASCAR concludes its 2026 season this weekend at Homestead-Miami Speedway. The Truck Series, O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, and Cup Series will each crown a champion across four days of racing. Coverage is split between NBC, HBO Max, FS1, and The CW.

stories.title: Allgaier leads O'Reilly Auto Parts series title race
stories.summary: Justin Allgaier enters the O'Reilly Auto Parts Championship Race with a 22-point lead over Jesse Love. The five-driver field includes Corey Day, Travis Kvapil, and Sheldon Creed. Allgaier, the defending series champion, is seeking to secure his second title at Homestead-Miami Speedway.

stories.title: Corey Day contends for NASCAR title
stories.summary: In his first full season, 20-year-old Corey Day has secured four wins and a spot in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series championship finale. Day stated that reaching this level of competition this year exceeded his initial expectations. He competes for the title this Saturday.

stories.title: Five drivers compete for O'Reilly series crown
stories.summary: Justin Allgaier holds a 22-point advantage heading into the final race of the O'Reilly Auto Parts Series at Homestead-Miami Speedway. He faces four challengers, including Jesse Love and Carson Kvapil. The championship will be decided this Saturday in a 200-lap event.

stories.title: Remembering F1 champion Alan Jones
stories.summary: Alan Jones, the 1980 Formula One world champion, has died at age 80. Jones was instrumental in establishing Williams Racing as a major force in the sport. His career is credited with providing the foundation for the team's long-term success in Formula One.

stories.title: Homestead-Miami weekend race preview
stories.summary: Homestead-Miami Speedway hosts the O'Reilly Auto Parts Series on Saturday and the NASCAR Cup Series on Sunday. The weekend features practice and qualifying sessions beginning Friday. Broadcasts are scheduled across The CW, NBC, and various radio platforms.

stories.title: Jhabakh and Sherif win Asia Pacific Rally title
stories.summary: Jeet Jhabakh and Musa Sherif have won the 2026 Asia Pacific Rally Championship, becoming the first all-Indian pairing to do so. Jhabakh is the first driver to win the title in a two-wheel-drive car. He finished the season 35 points ahead of his nearest rival.

stories.title: Arvid Lindblad celebrates Indian heritage
stories.summary: Teenage Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad is wearing a custom helmet featuring the Indian tricolor at the Interlagos circuit. Born to a Swedish father and a mother of Punjabi roots, Lindblad races under a British license. He is currently pursuing a career in Formula One.

stories.title: EU committee proposes low-carbon steel credits
stories.summary: The European Parliament Environment Committee has voted to lower 2035 automotive CO2 targets to 87.5 percent. The proposal includes credits for manufacturers using low-carbon steel produced in the EU. Eurofer suggests this move will help stimulate demand for cleaner industrial steel production.

stories.title: Hyundai outlines future mobility roadmap
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor Group presented its electrification and AI-based vehicle development strategy at the FISITA World Mobility Summit 2026. The group discussed software-defined vehicles and autonomous technology. Leaders emphasized the need for coordinated development across global automotive systems.

stories.title: Tesla leads imported car sales in South Korea
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz has overtaken BMW to become South Korea's second-best-selling imported car brand. Tesla retained the top spot, with 9,165 vehicles registered this year. The Model Y Premium was the best-selling imported model, followed by the Model 3. Tesla's cumulative sales in the country have reached 98,313 units.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The protective separation zone of a collaborative robot cell is commonly dimensioned for a worst case that disregards where the operator is actually present during the task. This paper presents a camera-based, data-driven method that configures. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Dynamic Watermarking and Action-Conditioned Latent Dynamics for Secure Vision-Based Controllers
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Replay attacks are difficult to detect in vision-based control systems because previously recorded observations can remain plausible while the physical system follows a different trajectory. This paper develops an adaptive dynamic-watermarking framework for detecting replay attacks. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Embodied RAG++: Retrieval-Augmented Generation From What Exists to What Works in Embodied Scenes
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: To serve a request in a human environment, a robot system must find an object that satisfies a functional requirement and a robot that can feasibly reach it. Scene graphs record which objects exist and where. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Geometry-Evolving Barrier Functions for Safety Evaluation in Dynamic Environments
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous systems operating in dynamic environments often involve multiple interacting agents, giving rise to high-dimensional safety evaluation problems. Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability provides rigorous finite-horizon safety guarantees, but solving a global HJ partial differential equation (PDE) over. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Optical Network Digital Twin: From Digital Coherent Transmission to Intelligent Network Operations
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical Network Digital Twins (ONDTs) are emerging as a key framework for representing, synchronizing, and utilizing the physical state of optical networks for quality-of-transmission (QoT) estimation, optimization, and intelligent operation. This survey provides a comprehensive view. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
